pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of scaling or adding sequential tickets within 60 seconds of a prior entry; zero averaging down into falling knives.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require confirmed multi-timeframe structural break and order-book imbalance confirmation before order placement, completely blocking entries during high-impact spread-widening windows.
profit_harvest_threshold: Instantly lock trailing stops or execute partial harvests when floating profits cross +$15.00 to prevent positive runs from evaporating into flat or negative closes.
